explanation.why_it_matters: With this tool, Claude Code users can now leverage Python code to perform complex tasks, extending the capabilities of the platform. This change enables more flexible and customized workflows.
how_to_use: Use the Code execution tool to execute Python scripts that interact with the Anthropic API
Run custom data processing tasks using Python code, within the secure sandboxed environment

items.summary: We've launched the MCP connector in public beta, a feature that allows you to connect to remote MCP servers directly from the Messages API.

explanation.what_it_is: The MCP connector is a feature that enables direct connections to remote MCP servers from the Messages API.
explanation.why_it_matters: This allows Claude Code users to integrate with MCP servers without needing intermediate infrastructure, simplifying their workflow.
how_to_use: Use the MCP connector to send messages to remote MCP servers
Configure the connector to receive messages from MCP servers and process them in your application

items.summary: To increase answer quality and decrease tool errors, we've changed the default value for the top_p nucleus sampling parameter in the Messages API from 0.999 to 0.99 for all models. To revert this…

explanation.what_it_is: The default value for the top_p nucleus sampling parameter in the Messages API has been changed from 0.999 to 0.99 for all models.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change aims to increase answer quality and decrease tool errors in the Anthropic API, potentially affecting the accuracy and reliability of model outputs.
how_to_use: Use the updated default value of 0.99 for top_p nucleus sampling parameter in your Messages API requests
Revert to the previous default value of 0.999 if needed, as described in the API documentation

items.title: We've moved our Go SDK from beta to GA
items.summary: We've moved our Go SDK from beta to GA.

explanation.what_it_is: The Go SDK for the Anthropic API has been promoted from beta to general availability (GA), indicating it is now stable and fully supported.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change means Claude Code users can rely on the Go SDK for production environments, as it is no longer considered experimental or subject to significant changes.
how_to_use: Use the Go SDK to build production-ready applications integrated with the Anthropic API
Update existing beta versions of the Go SDK to the GA version for stability and support

items.title: We've included minute and hour level granularity to the Usage page of Console…
items.summary: We've included minute and hour level granularity to the Usage page of Console alongside 429 error rates on the Usage page.

explanation.what_it_is: The Usage page of the Console now displays usage data at minute and hour levels, in addition to showing 429 error rates.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change allows Claude Code users to monitor their usage patterns more precisely and identify potential issues with their API requests, such as sudden spikes in errors.
how_to_use: Check the Usage page to view minute-level usage data for fine-grained insights into your API activity.
Use the hour-level granularity to track daily usage trends and optimize your API requests accordingly.
Monitor 429 error rates on the Usage page to quickly detect and address rate limiting issues.
